The listing's `field_metadata` gives every accepted value in `allowed_values`. A create with any other value is rejected with `400` and `invalid enum value for rule`.

position.description: Where the promotion shows on the search result page, such as `top` or `bottom`. Required on create. The listing's `field_metadata` gives every accepted value in `allowed_values`. A create with any other value is rejected with `400` and `invalid enum value for position`.

specific_keywords.description: The keywords for the `if_matches_specific_keywords` rule, which requires them. An empty string or `null` when not set.

is_active.description: Whether the promotion is on. Defaults to `true` on create.

is_always_available.description: Whether the promotion is always available. Defaults to `true` on create. When it is `false`, the listing's `field_metadata` marks `available_from_date` and `available_to_date` as required.

available_from_date.description: The start of the promotion's availability, or `null`.

available_to_date.description: The end of the promotion's availability, or `null`.

product_ids.description: The products in the promotion, as a list of product `id`s. On create, a value that is not a list of integers is rejected with `400` and `product_ids must be an array of integers`, and a product `id` that matches no product in your store with `400` and `unknown product id`.

fields.description: One entry per promotion field, keyed by field name: every field except the promotion's `id`, `created` and `updated`. The entries for `rule` and `position` list the values they accept in `allowed_values`.

kind.description: What the entry is: `resource`.

writable.description: Whether you can write the promotions: `true`.

max_items.description: The most promotions the collection holds. The `group_meta` returned with the settings does not include it.

total.description: The number of promotions in the collection.

limit.description: The collection's own limit, such as `20`. It does not change with the `limit` you send.

offset.description: The number of promotions skipped before this page.

count.description: The number of promotions on this page.

has_next.description: Whether there is a next page.

has_previous.description: Whether there is a previous page.

previous_page.description: The URL of the previous page, or `null` when `has_previous` is `false`.

next_page.description: The next page, or `null` on the last page.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `not_found`, `method_not_allowed` or `rate_limited`.

message.description: What went wrong, such as `seo is a read-only section`.

details.description: More detail, or an empty list.

CartPage.description: What the cart page offers a shopper.

show_product_thumbnail.description: Show product images on the cart page. The store's default is `true`.

enable_clear_cart.description: Show a button that empties the cart. The store's default is `false`.

save_cart.description: Show the Save cart button on the cart page. The button comes from the `save-cart` plugin. The store's default is `false`.

FlyingCart.description: The slide-out flying cart, and what it offers a shopper.

enabled.description: Show the slide-out flying cart. The store's default is `false`.

enable_clear_cart.description: Show the empty cart button inside the flying cart. Its `field_metadata` entry has `requires: "enabled"`. Setting `enabled` to `false` does not change this field's stored value. The store's default is `false`.

save_cart.description: Show the Save cart action inside the flying cart. The action comes from the `save-cart` plugin. Its `field_metadata` entry has `requires: "enabled"`. Setting `enabled` to `false` does not change this field's stored value. The store's default is `false`.

ShoppingCartGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. Only [Get shopping cart settings](/api-reference/shopping-cart/get-shopping-cart-settings) and [Update shopping cart settings](/api-reference/shopping-cart/update-shopping-cart-settings) return it.

kind.description: What the section is. `setting` for both sections.

writable.description: Whether you can write to the section. `true` for both sections.

href.description: The section's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/page_settings/shopping_cart/cart_page`.

ShoppingCartFieldMetadata.description: Describes every field, keyed by section and then by field name.

ShoppingCartSectionFieldMetadata.description: One entry for each of the section's fields, keyed by field name.

ui_label.description: The field's label, such as `Display Flying Cart`.

description.description: What the field does.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes. `boolean` for every shopping cart field.

default.description: The field's default value.

plugin.description: The plugin that provides the feature: `save-cart`. Only the two `save_cart` fields have it.

requires.description: The field of the same section that this one depends on: `enabled`. Only `flying_cart.enable_clear_cart` and `flying_cart.save_cart` have it.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `not_found` or `method_not_allowed`.

message.description: What went wrong. For an unknown section, it is `Unknown page-settings section: shopping_cart/<section>`.

details.description: More about the rejection. When a section write is not wrapped in the section's name, the first entry's `field` names the section and its `code` is `required`.

field.description: The field or wrapper the rejection is about.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `required`.

request_id.description: Identifies the request. A response that repeats an earlier rejection has a new `request_id`.

AnimationEffectsInput.description: Name only the sections and fields that change.

PreloaderDesign.description: The loader shown while a page loads, and when and where it shows.

enable_preloader.description: Show the preloader while a page loads.

enable_custom_preloader.description: Show your own uploaded loader instead of the preset in `preloader_preset`.

preloader_preset.description: The preset loader. `field_metadata` gives a label for each value under `options`, such as `Flying dots` for `pulse_circle`.

preloader_size.description: The loader's size in pixels, from `20` to `300`.

preloader_background_opacity.description: The preloader's background opacity, from `0` to `1`.

background_preloader.description: The preloader's background colour, as a hex or CSS colour, such as `#ffffff`.

preloader_hide_condition.description: When the preloader hides: `auto`, or `x_seconds` to hide it after `preloader_hide_after_time` seconds.

preloader_hide_after_time.description: Seconds before the preloader hides, from `0.2` to `5`. Used when `preloader_hide_condition` is `x_seconds`.

preloader_page.description: Which pages show the preloader: `all`, or `custom` for only the pages in `preloader_custom_page`.

preloader_custom_page.description: The pages that show the preloader when `preloader_page` is `custom`, each as the page's `id` and `name`. A write takes each page's `id`, and also accepts these records.

PreloaderDesignInput.description: The `preloader_design` fields a write accepts. `custom_loader` is not one of them.

enable_preloader.description: Show the preloader while a page loads.

enable_custom_preloader.description: Show your own uploaded loader instead of the preset in `preloader_preset`.

preloader_preset.description: The preset loader. `field_metadata` gives a label for each value under `options`, such as `Flying dots` for `pulse_circle`.

preloader_size.description: The loader's size in pixels, from `20` to `300`.

preloader_background_opacity.description: The preloader's background opacity, from `0` to `1`.

background_preloader.description: The preloader's background colour, as a hex or CSS colour, such as `#ffffff`.

preloader_hide_condition.description: When the preloader hides: `auto`, or `x_seconds` to hide it after `preloader_hide_after_time` seconds.

preloader_hide_after_time.description: Seconds before the preloader hides, from `0.2` to `5`. Used when `preloader_hide_condition` is `x_seconds`.

preloader_page.description: Which pages show the preloader: `all`, or `custom` for only the pages in `preloader_custom_page`.

preloader_custom_page.description: The ids of the pages that show the preloader, such as `[70, 1]`. A write also accepts the records a read returns, with each page's `id` and `name`. The list cannot be empty while `preloader_page` is `custom`, and a page `id` that matches no page is rejected with `400 invalid_request`. `field_metadata` lists the pages you can choose under `options`.

PreloaderPage.description: One page that shows the preloader.

id.description: The page's `id`. A write sends this value in `preloader_custom_page`.

name.description: The page's name.

CustomLoader.description: The loader file uploaded for `enable_custom_preloader`. Read-only: `field_metadata` has no entry for it, and a write body that names only `custom_loader` is rejected with `400 invalid_request`.

enabled.description: `true` when a loader file has been uploaded.

file_name.description: The uploaded file's name, or `null` when there is none.

file_url.description: The uploaded file's URL, or `null` when there is none.

WidgetTransition.description: Whether widgets fade in, and for how long.

widget_smooth_render_duration.description: How long the fade takes, in milliseconds, from `0` to `1000`.

PageTransition.description: The animation between pages, and when it plays.

transition_animation_duration.description: How long the animation takes, in seconds, from `0.3` to `5`.

animation_before_entering_new_page.description: Play the animation before entering a new page.

animation_after_entering_new_page.description: Play the animation after entering a new page.

ImageLazyEffect.description: Which pages lazy-load images, and the loader and placeholder they show.

preloader_image_lazy_effect_preset.description: The preset lazy loader. It takes the same values as `preloader_design.preloader_preset`.

product_details_page_image_lazy_effect.description: Lazy-load images on the product details page.

flying_cart_image_lazy_effect.description: Lazy-load images in the flying cart popup.

product_list_image_lazy_effect.description: Lazy-load images on product list pages.

property_list_image_lazy_effect.description: Lazy-load images on property list pages.

property_details_page_image_lazy_effect.description: Lazy-load images on the property details page.

blog_list_image_lazy_effect.description: Lazy-load images on blog list pages.

blog_details_page_image_lazy_effect.description: Lazy-load images on the blog details page.

lazy_loader_size.description: The lazy loader's size in pixels, from `20` to `300`.

background_lazy_loader.description: The lazy loader's background colour, as a hex or CSS colour, such as `#ffffff`.

content_image_lazy_load_background.description: The CSS background of the image placeholder.

PageSkeleton.description: The checkout page skeleton setting. It is the section's only field.

checkout_page_skeleton.description: Turn on the checkout page skeleton. A value that is not a boolean is rejected with `400 invalid_request`.

AnimationEffectsGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. Only [Get animation effects settings](/api-reference/animation-effects/get-animation-effects-settings) and [Update animation effects settings](/api-reference/animation-effects/update-animation-effects-settings) return it.

kind.description: What the section is. `setting` for all five sections.

writable.description: Whether you can write to the section. `true` for all five sections.

href.description: The section's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/animation_effects/preloader_design`.

AnimationEffectsFieldMetadata.description: On [Get animation effects settings](/api-reference/animation-effects/get-animation-effects-settings) it is keyed by section and then by field name. On a section it is keyed by field name. `custom_loader` has no entry.

anyOf.description: One section's fields, keyed by field name.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes.

description.description: More about the value the field takes, on some fields, such as `Hex or CSS color.`

default.description: The field's default value. `preloader_custom_page` and `content_image_lazy_load_background` have none.

allowed_values.description: The values the field accepts, for an `enum` field.

options.description: For `preloader_preset` and `preloader_image_lazy_effect_preset`, a `value` and a `label` for each allowed value. For `preloader_custom_page`, each page you can choose, as the page's `id` and `name`.

min.description: The lowest value, for an `integer` or `decimal` field.

max.description: The highest value, for an `integer` or `decimal` field.

depends_on.description: The field this one depends on: `preloader_hide_condition` for `preloader_hide_after_time`, and `preloader_page` for `preloader_custom_page`.

references.description: The kind of record an `id_list` field points to: `page` for `preloader_custom_page`, which holds page ids.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request` or `not_found`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field. Empty when the error is not about a field.

field.description: The field that was rejected.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field` or `invalid_enum`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

CustomerPortalSettings.description: All six sections. `profile_page` and `registration_fields` are read-only.

CustomerPortalSettingsInput.description: The writable sections. Name only these four.

CustomerPortalPortal.description: The switch that turns the customer portal on or off.

enabled.description: Turn the customer portal on. Defaults to `false`.

CustomerPortalRegistration.description: Who can register, as what, and what they must accept.

enabled.description: Let customers register. Defaults to `false`.

close_registration_message.description: The HTML message shown while registration is closed, or `null`.

assign_default_group.description: Assign each new registrant to a default customer group, from `default_groups`. Defaults to `false`.

default_groups.description: The customer groups a new registrant joins. A read returns each customer group as an `{id, name}` object. A write takes the customer groups' `id` values, such as `[4]`, and also accepts the objects from a read. At most 100 entries; duplicates are removed and each customer group must exist.

requires_approval.description: New customers need admin approval. Defaults to `false`.

approval_groups.description: Customer groups, read and written the same way as `default_groups`: a read returns each customer group as an `{id, name}` object, and a write takes the customer groups' `id` values, such as `[4]`. At most 100 entries; duplicates are removed and each customer group must exist.

CustomerPortalCustomerGroup.description: A customer group, as a read returns it.

id.description: The customer group's `id`. A write takes this number on its own.

name.description: The customer group's name.

CustomerPortalRegistrationTerms.description: Whether a registrant must accept terms, and where the terms are.

enabled.description: Require registrants to accept the terms. Defaults to `false`. You cannot turn it on while `terms.reference` is `null`: the write is rejected with `400` and `a terms reference is required when terms are enabled`.

text.description: The acceptance text, such as `By registering, I accept the`.

anchor_text.description: The link text, such as `Terms and Conditions`. At most 255 characters.

type.description: Where the terms are: `page`, `link` or `text`. Any other value is rejected with `400`.

reference.description: Depends on `type`: an existing page's `id` when `type` is `page`, a safe `http(s)` or same-site URL when `type` is `link`, or free text when `type` is `text`.

enabled.description: Turn on Facebook login. Defaults to `false`.

app_id.description: The Facebook app ID. Required when `facebook.enabled` is `true`.

enabled.description: Turn on Google login. Defaults to `false`.

client_id.description: The Google client ID. Required when `google.enabled` is `true`.

CustomerPortalB2bConfiguration.description: What a new registrant is created as.

enabled.description: Turn on the B2B configuration. Defaults to `false`.

create_as_organisation.description: Create a new registrant as an organisation.

create_as_customer.description: Create a new registrant as a customer.

CustomerPortalAlternateLogin.description: Third-party login, and whether it offers an email field.

enabled.description: Turn on third-party login. Defaults to `false`.

enable_email_field.description: Show an email field. Depends on `alternate_login.enabled`. Defaults to `false`.

CustomerPortalLogin.description: Whether customers can sign in, and what the sign-in page offers.

enabled.description: Let customers sign in. Defaults to `false`.

login_disabled_message.description: The HTML message shown while login is turned off, or `null`.

awaiting_approval_message.description: The HTML message shown to a customer whose registration is awaiting approval.

enable_landing_page_after_successful_log.description: Send customers to `landing_page_after_successful_login` after they sign in. While this is `false`, that page is not used. Defaults to `false`.

landing_page_after_successful_login.description: The same-site path or URL customers land on after they sign in, or `null` to clear it. Used only when `enable_landing_page_after_successful_login` is `true`.

CustomerPortalLoginCaptcha.description: The captcha shown after failed login attempts.

enabled.description: Show a captcha after failed login attempts. Defaults to `false`.

fail_count.description: The number of failed attempts before the captcha shows. From `1` to `50`: any other value is rejected with `400` and `must be between 1 and 50`.

CustomerPortalSso.description: Single sign-on. Setting `enabled` to `true` on its own is rejected with `400`: `tenant_name`, `policy_name`, `client_id` and `client_secret` under `azure_ad_b2c` are each reported as `required`.

enabled.description: Turn on customer SSO. Defaults to `false`.

require_site_access.description: Turn on the option labelled `Required customer to access site`. It can be `true` only while `sso.enabled` is `true`; otherwise the write is rejected with `400` and `require_site_access can only be enabled when SSO is enabled`. Defaults to `false`.

CustomerPortalAzureAd.description: The Azure AD (SAML) provider. Required when `service_provider` is `AZURE_AD`.

reply_url_postfix.description: The end of the reply URL, such as `customer/azureSamlResponse`.

CustomerPortalAzureAdDataMapping.description: The SAML assertion attribute for each customer field.

post_code.description: The attribute for the post code.

phone.description: The attribute for the phone number.

mobile.description: The attribute for the mobile number.

CustomerPortalAzureAdB2c.description: The Azure AD B2C provider. Required when `service_provider` is `AZURE_AD_B2C`.

client_secret.description: The B2C client secret. `field_metadata` types it as a plain `string`, with no secret or write-only marker.

reply_url_prefix.description: The start of the reply URL: your store's address, such as `https://your-store.example.com/`.

reply_url_postfix.description: The end of the reply URL, such as `customer/azureAdB2CResponse`.

CustomerPortalProfilePage.description: The customer's profile page. Read-only: `group_meta` marks it `writable: false`.

page_html.description: The welcome message, as HTML, or `null`.

tabs.description: The profile page tabs, including tabs that plugins add.

overview.description: The product blocks on the Overview tab, such as `overview_top_selling_product`.

my_entitlements.description: The entries on the My Entitlements tab, such as `store_credit`, `gift_card` and `loyalty_point`.

CustomerPortalProfileField.description: One field of a form on the profile page.

CustomerPortalProfileEntry.description: One entry of a list on the profile page: a tab, a section or an entitlement.

CustomerPortalProfileOverviewEntry.description: One product block on the Overview tab.

show_product_info.description: Show product information. Only some blocks have this field.

CustomerPortalManageMyAccount.description: The Manage My Account tab: its sections and form fields.

account_information.description: The fields of the account information form.

billing_address.description: The fields of the billing address form.

shipping_address.description: The fields of the shipping address form.

CustomerPortalMyOrders.description: What the My Orders tab shows, and which order lists it offers.

sections.description: The order lists, such as `all_order` and `preorder`.

CustomerPortalMyOrderFlags.description: Six switches for the My Orders tab.

display_track_in_column.description: Show tracking in a column. Needs `show_track_my_orders` set to `true`.

CustomerPortalAssignToCustomer.description: The assigned pages tab, and how it paginates.

show_pagination.description: Where the pagination control shows: `top`, `bottom` or `top_and_bottom`, or `null`.

item_per_page.description: Items per page, from `1` to `999999`, or `null`.

CustomerPortalRegistrationFields.description: The fields of the registration form. Read-only: `group_meta` marks it `writable: false`.

fields.description: One entry per registration form field.

CustomerPortalRegistrationField.description: One field of the registration form.

label.description: The label you set for the field, or `null` when none is set.

default_label.description: The field's default label, such as `First Name`.

active.description: Show the field on the registration form.

required.description: The registrant must fill in the field.

system.description: `true` for a built-in field, whose `active` and `required` cannot be turned off.

order.description: The field's position on the form.

placeholder.description: The placeholder text. Not every field has one.

CustomerPortalGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. Only [Get customer portal settings](/api-reference/customer-portal/get-customer-portal-settings) and [Update customer portal settings](/api-reference/customer-portal/update-customer-portal-settings) return it.

kind.description: `setting` for `portal`, `registration`, `login` and `sso`; `resource` for `profile_page` and `registration_fields`.

writable.description: Whether you can write the section. `true` for the four `setting` sections and `false` for the two `resource` sections. Trust this field, not the `Allow` header, which lists `PATCH` on all six.

href.description: The section's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/customer_portal/login`.

CustomerPortalFieldMetadata.description: Has the same nesting as the settings, with a `CustomerPortalFieldMetadataEntry` in place of each value. `sso.azure_ad` and `sso.azure_ad_b2c` also have a `_required_when` entry, which states when the whole block is required, such as `service_provider=AZURE_AD`.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes: `boolean`, `string`, `html`, `integer`, `enum`, `id_list` or `object_list`.

description.description: What the field does, or a rule about it.

default.description: The field's default value.

allowed_values.description: The values the field accepts, for an `enum` field.

min.description: The lowest value, for an `integer` field.

max.description: The highest value, for an `integer` field.

max_length.description: The longest text the field accepts.

max_items.description: The most entries an `id_list` field accepts.

depends_on.description: The field this one depends on, such as `enabled`.

required_when.description: The field that makes this one required, such as `enabled`.

read_only.description: `true` on a field you cannot change, such as a row's `key`.

item.description: For an `object_list` field, a description of each field of one row.

applies_to.description: The rows the field applies to.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request` or `not_found`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field. Empty when the error is not about a field.

field.description: The field that was rejected, such as `portal.enabled`.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field`, `invalid_boolean`, `constraint_violation` or `required`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

order_flags.description: The store's order flags. Read-only here: manage them through `/api/v4/admin/order_flags`.

EcommerceSettingsInput.description: The fields to change, grouped by section. `order_flags` cannot be written here.

ContinueShoppingSettings.description: The `continue_shopping` section: where the continue shopping link leads.

enable_continue_shopping.description: Turn continue shopping on or off.

continue_shopping_target.description: Where continue shopping leads: `home`, `previous` or `specified`. With `specified`, `continue_shopping_specified_target` names the page.

continue_shopping_specified_target.description: The slug of the page to link to. Required when `continue_shopping_target` is `specified`. `field_metadata` lists every page slug in your store under `options`, and a slug that names no page is rejected with `400 invalid_reference` and the message `not a known page slug`.

ProductInventorySettings.description: The `product_inventory` section: out-of-stock handling and when a sale reduces stock.

low_stock_notification.description: Get a low stock notification by email.

out_of_stock_notification.description: Get an out of stock notification by email.

hide_on_sale_tag_for_out_of_stock_produc.description: Do not display the "On Sale" tag on a sold out product.

order_quantity_over_stock.description: The stock rule when an order quantity is more than the stock: `add_available`, `sell_away`, `allow_admin_only_to_add_out_of_stock_products` or `do_not_sell`.

PricingSettings.description: The `pricing` section: minimum purchase amounts, on account purchase, credit limit and payment terms.

update_price_range.description: Adjust the price range for the product.

enable_minimum_purchase_amount.description: Turn on the minimum purchase amount.

minimum_purchase_amount.description: The minimum purchase amount. Depends on `enable_minimum_purchase_amount`, and is required and greater than `0` while it is on.

enable_minimum_purchase_amount_in_cart.description: Turn on the minimum purchase amount in cart details.

minimum_purchase_amount_in_cart.description: The minimum purchase amount in cart details. Depends on `enable_minimum_purchase_amount_in_cart`, and is required and greater than `0` while it is on.

assign_credit_limit_per_order.description: Set a credit limit for the account. Depends on `enable_on_account_purchase`.

credit_limit_per_order.description: The credit limit. Depends on `assign_credit_limit_per_order`, and is required while it is on. `0` is allowed and grants no credit. Can be `null`.

payment_terms.description: The net payment term: `NET_30`, `NET_60` or `NET_90`, written and returned as that string. Depends on `enable_payment_terms`. Can be `null`.

ProductRestrictionSettings.description: The `product_restriction` section: one switch for product restriction based on the parent category.

enable_product_restriction_based_on_pare.description: Allow product restriction based on the parent category.

OrderFilterSettings.description: The `order_filters` section: the status each admin order list opens on. A field is `null` when no default is set.

default_order_status.description: The default order status: `all`, `paused`, `in_progress`, `completed` or `reopened`, or `null` when unset.

default_payment_status.description: The default payment status: `all`, `paid`, `unpaid` or `partially_paid`, or `null` when unset.

default_shipment_status.description: The default shipment status: `all`, `unshipped`, `shipped`, `returned` or `partial`, or `null` when unset.

LocationSettings.description: The `location_settings` section. Only `enable_multi_location` can be written.

locations.description: A read-only list of your stock locations. Manage them through `/api/v4/admin/inventory_locations`. A body that sends `locations` is rejected with `400 invalid_request` and the message `no recognized ecommerce_settings fields in body`.

LocationSettingsInput.description: The `location_settings` fields you can write. `locations` is read-only.

EcommerceSettingsLocation.description: One stock location, as `location_settings.locations` lists it.

id.description: The stock location's `id`, which `/api/v4/admin/inventory_locations/{inventory_location_id}` takes as `inventory_location_id`.

name.description: The location's name.

address.description: The location's address, or `null` when none is set.

default.description: `true` on the store's default location.

created_at.description: When the location was created, such as `2026-07-16T06:24:24`.

updated_at.description: When the location was last changed.

EcommerceSettingsOrderFlag.description: One order flag, as `order_flags` lists it.

id.description: The order flag's `id`, which `/api/v4/admin/order_flags/{order_flag_id}` takes as `order_flag_id`.

name.description: The flag's name.

color.description: The flag's colour as a hex code, such as `#FF6868`.

description.description: The flag's description, or `null`.

type.description: The flag's type, such as `order`.

EcommerceSettingsGroupMeta.description: One entry per key under `ecommerce_settings`. Only [Get ecommerce settings](/api-reference/ecommerce-settings/get-ecommerce-settings) and [Update ecommerce settings](/api-reference/ecommerce-settings/update-ecommerce-settings) return it.

kind.description: `setting` for the six sections, `collection` for `order_flags`.

writable.description: `true` for the six sections, `false` for `order_flags`.

href.description: The key's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/ecommerce_settings/pricing`. For `order_flags` it is `/api/v4/admin/order_flags`.

locations_href.description: Only on `location_settings`: `/api/v4/admin/inventory_locations`, where you manage the stock locations.

EcommerceSettingsFieldMetadata.description: Describes each field with an `EcommerceSettingsFieldMetadataEntry`. On `/ecommerce_settings` it is keyed by section and then by field name; on a section it is keyed by field name.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes: `boolean`, `enum`, `decimal`, `reference` or `collection`.

default.description: The field's default value, when it has one.

nullable.description: `true` when the field can be empty.

depends_on.description: The field this one depends on, such as `enable_minimum_purchase_amount`.

description.description: A note about the field's values, on some fields, such as `Empty = unset.`

references.description: What a `reference` field points to: `page` for `continue_shopping_specified_target`.

options.description: For `continue_shopping_specified_target`, every page slug in your store.

writable.description: `false` on `locations`, which you cannot write.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request` or `not_found`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field. Empty when the error is not about a field.

field.description: The field that was rejected.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field` or `invalid_enum`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

PriceDisplayOrderItem.description: The `order_item` section: how each line item's own price shows.

price_including_tax.description: Show each line item's price with tax included.

price_including_discount.description: Show each line item's price with the discount included.

tax_in_line.description: Show the tax on each line item. Accepts the `shopping_cart` and `order_success` surfaces only.

discount_in_line_item.description: Show the discount on each line item.

item_total_including_tax.description: Show each line item's total with tax included. Accepts the `shopping_cart` and `order_success` surfaces only.

PriceDisplayOrderSummary.description: The `order_summary` section: the lines of the order summary and what each one includes.

order_total_excluding_tax.description: Show the order total with tax excluded.

order_total_including_discount.description: Show the order total with the discount included.

subtotal_tax.description: Show the subtotal tax line. One `enabled` value covers the shopping cart, checkout and the order success page.

total_tax.description: Show the total tax line. One `enabled` value covers checkout and the order success page.

order_total.description: Show the order total line. One `enabled` value covers the shopping cart, checkout and the order success page.

payment_surcharge.description: Show the payment surcharge in the order summary. Accepts the `checkout` and `order_success` surfaces only.

PriceDisplayScopes.description: The surfaces a setting applies to. A block accepts only the surfaces its `field_metadata` entry lists in `allowed_scopes`. A write that sends any other key is rejected with `400 invalid_request` and the reason `invalid_enum`.

PriceDisplayScopedToggle.description: A setting with a master switch and optional control per surface.

enabled.description: The master switch. While `customize` is `false`, every surface in `scopes` follows it.

customize.description: Set each surface in `scopes` yourself instead of following `enabled`.

scopes.description: The surfaces this setting applies to when `customize` is `true`.

PriceDisplayPlainToggle.description: A setting with only a master switch and no control per surface.

enabled.description: Turn the setting on or off.

PriceDisplaySubtotal.description: The subtotal line: where it shows, and whether it includes tax and discount.

show.description: Show the subtotal line on each surface.

include_tax.description: Show the subtotal with tax included.

include_discount.description: Show the subtotal with the discount included.

PriceDisplayDiscount.description: The discount line: where it shows, whether it hides when zero, and whether it includes tax.

show.description: Show the discount line on each surface.

hide_if_zero.description: Hide the discount line when the discount is zero.

include_tax.description: Show the discount with tax included.

PriceDisplayShippingCost.description: The shipping cost line: where it shows, and whether it includes tax and discount. Accepts the `checkout` and `order_success` surfaces only.

show.description: Show the shipping cost line on each surface.

include_tax.description: Show the shipping cost with tax included.

include_discount.description: Show the shipping cost with the discount included.

PriceDisplayShippingDiscount.description: The shipping discount line and the shipping tax line. Accepts the `checkout` and `order_success` surfaces only.

show.description: Show the shipping discount line on each surface.

include_tax.description: Show the shipping discount with tax included.

shipping_tax.description: Show the shipping tax line. One `enabled` value covers checkout and the order success page.

PriceDisplayHandling.description: The handling cost, shown apart from shipping, and its tax settings. Accepts the `checkout` and `order_success` surfaces only.

show_separately.description: Show the handling cost separately from shipping, on each surface.

include_tax.description: Show the handling cost with tax included.

handling_tax.description: Show the handling tax in the order summary.

PriceDisplayPricingInfo.description: A pricing information note shown after the total, and whether the order success page hides the due amount.

enabled.description: Show a custom pricing information note after the total.

text.description: The note's text. At most 2000 characters: a longer value is rejected with `400 invalid_request` and the reason `too_long`.

customize.description: Set the surfaces in `scopes` yourself instead of following `enabled`.

scopes.description: The surfaces the note shows on.

do_not_show_due_amount.description: Hide the due amount on the order success page.

PriceDisplayGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. Only [Get price display settings](/api-reference/price-display-settings/get-price-display-settings) and [Update price display settings](/api-reference/price-display-settings/update-price-display-settings) return it.

kind.description: What the section is. `setting` for both sections.

writable.description: Whether you can write to the section. `true` for both sections.

href.description: The section's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/price_display_settings/order_item`.

PriceDisplayFieldMetadata.description: Has the same nesting as the settings, with a `PriceDisplayFieldMetadataEntry` in place of each setting. A `scopes`, `show` or `show_separately` object gets one `scope_flags` entry. On `/price_display_settings` it is keyed by section; on a section path it holds that section under its own name.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes: `boolean`, `string` or `scope_flags`.

description.description: What the field does.

default.description: The field's default value, for a `boolean` or `string` field.

allowed_scopes.description: The surfaces the block accepts, for a `scope_flags` field.

scope_labels.description: A label for each surface in `allowed_scopes`.

max_length.description: The longest value accepted, for a `string` field. Only `order_summary.pricing_info.text` has it, set to `2000`.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request` or `not_found`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field. Empty when the error is not about a field.

field.description: The field that was rejected.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field` or `invalid_enum`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

ProductListingSettings.description: The product listing settings, in four sections.

ProductListingProductInformation.description: What each product shows on a listing tile.

show_summary.description: Show the product summary on each tile.

show_sale_percentage.description: Show the sale percentage on each tile.

show_stock_availability.description: Show the stock availability on each tile.

show_parent_category.description: Show the product's parent category on each tile.

show_loyalty_point.description: Show loyalty points on each tile.

show_variations_as_products.description: Show variations as separate products in the listing.

ProductListingInteractionButtons.description: The add to cart and view details buttons on each listing tile.

enabled.description: Show the buttons on each tile.

add_to_cart.description: Show the add to cart button.

ProductListingPrice.description: Which prices each listing tile shows.

enabled.description: Show the price.

expect_to_pay.description: Show the expect to pay price.

expect_to_pay_with_tax.description: Show the expect to pay price with tax.

ProductListingReviews.description: The rating stars on each listing tile and the review count beside them.

show_review_count.description: Show the review count beside the stars.

ProductListingVariationCombination.description: Which variation types each listing tile combines.

enabled.description: Show variation combinations on each tile.

types.description: Names of your store's variation types, such as `Color`. The entry for this field in `field_metadata` lists the names you can send under `allowed_values`. Any other name is rejected with `400` and `unknown variation type`.

ProductListingLoad.description: Whether a listing pages or loads more. `type` selects which block applies.

enabled.description: Turn the load settings on.

type.description: How the listing loads products: `pagination` uses the `pagination` block and `load_more` uses the `load_more` block. Any other value is rejected with `400`.

ProductListingLoadPagination.description: Where the pager shows and how many products a page holds.

position.description: Where the pager shows: `top`, `bottom` or `top_and_bottom`, or `null`. Any other value is rejected with `400`.

per_page.description: Products per page, from `1` to `999999`. `0` is rejected with `must be a positive integer for the selected load type`, and `1000000` with `must be between 1 and 999999`.

allow_user_per_page.description: Let shoppers change the number of products per page.

ProductListingLoadMore.description: How many products each press of load more adds.

per_load.description: Products added each time a shopper presses load more, from `1` to `999999`. While `load.type` is `pagination`, `0` is accepted.

ProductListingSorting.description: The order a listing is shown in.

enabled.description: Turn sorting on.

sort_by.description: The sort order: `alpha_asc`, `alpha_desc`, `price_desc`, `price_asc`, `created_asc` or `created_desc`, or `null`. Any other value is rejected with `400`.

ProductListingSortableItems.description: Whether a shopper can re-sort a listing, and by what.

enabled.description: Let shoppers re-sort the listing.

ProductListingSortableOptions.description: The sort orders a shopper can pick from.

ProductListingGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. No entry has an `href`, because no section has a path of its own.

kind.description: What the section is. `setting` for all four sections.

writable.description: Whether you can write to the section. `true` for all four sections.

ProductListingFieldMetadata.description: Keyed by section, then nested the same way as that section's settings, with a `ProductListingFieldMetadataEntry` in place of each field's value. Every field has an entry, and there are no other entries.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes, such as `enum_list` for `product_information.variation_combination.types`.

allowed_values.description: The values the field accepts. For `product_information.variation_combination.types`, the names of your store's variation types.

depends_on.description: Present on a field that depends on another field's value, such as `load.load_more.per_load`. A write to the field is still accepted when that other value does not switch it on.

ProductListingError.description: Describes why the request was rejected. The message gives the reason, such as `request body must be wrapped in a 'product_listing' object`.

SearchableContent.description: The search box's placeholder text, and the content types the search covers.

placeholder_text.description: The placeholder text in the search box.

SearchableContentGroup.description: One content type the search covers: `product`, `blog` or `other_pages`.

enabled.description: Include this content type in search results. Defaults to `false`.

display_heading.description: The heading displayed for this content type. At most 50 characters: a longer heading is rejected with `400`.

excluded.description: The items hidden from search results for this content type. A read returns each item as an `{id, name}` record, where `id` is the product's `id` under `product`, the blog's `id` under `blog` and the page's `id` under `other_pages`. A write takes a list of those ids, or the same records. A value that is not a list, or an id that is not an integer, is rejected with `400`.

SearchableProductCategories.description: The `product_categories` content type. It has one field the other content types do not: `hide_parent_category`.

enabled.description: Include this content type in search results. Defaults to `false`.

hide_parent_category.description: Hide the parent category in searched products. Defaults to `false`.

display_heading.description: The heading displayed for this content type. At most 50 characters: a longer heading is rejected with `400`.

excluded.description: The items hidden from search results for this content type. A read returns each item as an `{id, name}` record, where `id` is the product category's `id`. A write takes a list of those ids, or the same records. A value that is not a list, or an id that is not an integer, is rejected with `400`.

SearchExcludedItem.description: One item hidden from search results.

id.description: The excluded item's `id`: the product's `id` under `product`, the product category's `id` under `product_categories`, the blog's `id` under `blog`, and the page's `id` under `other_pages`. A write can send these ids alone instead of records.

name.description: The excluded item's name.

SearchFields.description: How a query is matched, and which product fields it is matched against.

fields.description: The product fields a query is matched against, each with its priority. Each field and each priority may appear once, and `title` must be in the list at priority `1`. A list that breaks one of these rules is rejected with `400`.

SearchFieldPriority.description: One product field and where it ranks.

field.description: The product field. Any other value is rejected with `400`.

priority.description: Where the field ranks, from `1` to `10`. `title` must be `1`. A value outside `1` to `10` is rejected with `400`.

Synonyms.description: Groups of words that a search treats as synonyms of each other. Changing synonyms triggers an Elasticsearch reindex.

keywords.description: The words in the group. Each group needs at least two: a group with fewer is rejected with `400`.

SearchSettingsGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. Only [Get search settings](/api-reference/search-settings/get-search-settings), [Update search settings](/api-reference/search-settings/update-search-settings) and [Replace search settings](/api-reference/search-settings/replace-search-settings) return it.

kind.description: What the section is. `setting` for all three sections.

writable.description: Whether you can write to the section. `true` for all three sections.

href.description: The section's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/search_settings/search_fields`.

state.description: The reindex state, such as `idle` or `completed`.

error.description: The error the reindex reported, or `null`.

SearchSettingsFieldMetadata.description: Describes every field in the response and nothing else. It has the same nesting as the settings, with a `SearchSettingsFieldMetadataEntry` in place of each field. A list of rows, such as `search_fields.fields`, has one entry, and its `item` describes the fields of each row. On `/search_settings` it is keyed by section; on a section it is keyed by field name.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes: `boolean`, `string`, `integer`, `enum`, `id_list`, `string_list`, `object_list` or `group_list`.

description.description: What the field holds, when the store gives a description.

default.description: The field's default value.

max_length.description: The longest value accepted, for a `string` field. `50` for `display_heading`.

allowed_values.description: The values the field accepts, for an `enum` field.

min.description: The lowest value, for an `integer` field.

max.description: The highest value, for an `integer` field.

item.description: Describes each row's fields, for an `object_list` or `group_list` field.

rules.description: Rules the list must follow, such as `title required at priority 1` or `each group needs >= 2 keywords`.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `not_found` or `method_not_allowed`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field. Empty when the error is not about a field.

field.description: The path of the rejected field, such as `search_fields.fields`.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field`, `invalid_enum` or `duplicate`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

SeoConfiguration.description: The three settings sections and the rows of `document_root`. The rows of `redirects` are inside `url_settings`.

SeoConfigurationInput.description: The settings sections you can write, by name. `document_root` and `redirects` have their own calls.

SeoGlobalStoreSettings.description: The store name, the title separator, and the title and description templates for pages, products and categories.

store_name.description: The store name that the `{site_name}` token puts in titles. Required: an empty value is rejected with `400` (`Site Name is required`).

title_separator.description: The title separator. Required. Any other value is rejected with `400` (`invalid_enum`).

SeoPagesTemplates.description: The indexing setting and the title and description templates for pages.

disable_indexing.description: Stop search engines indexing your pages. Defaults to `false`.

title_template.description: The tokens that build the title, in order. Any other token is rejected with `400` (`invalid_enum`), and a value that is not an array with `invalid_type`.

description_template.description: The tokens that build the meta description, in order.

SeoProductsTemplates.description: The indexing setting and the title and description templates for products.

disable_indexing.description: Stop search engines indexing your products. Defaults to `false`.

title_template.description: The tokens that build the title, in order. Any other token is rejected with `400` (`invalid_enum`), and a value that is not an array with `invalid_type`.

description_template.description: The tokens that build the meta description, in order.

SeoCategoriesTemplates.description: The indexing setting and the title and description templates for categories.

disable_indexing.description: Stop search engines indexing your categories. Defaults to `false`.

title_template.description: The tokens that build the title, in order. Any other token is rejected with `400` (`invalid_enum`), and a value that is not an array with `invalid_type`.

description_template.description: The tokens that build the meta description, in order.

SeoCustomCode.description: Code the storefront adds to every page: `header` in `<head>`, `footer` before `</body>`.

enabled.description: Add this block's code to every page. Defaults to `false`.

code.description: Raw HTML or JavaScript. `field_metadata` lists it as requiring its block's `enabled`.

SeoUrlSettings.description: The two URL settings, and the rows of `redirects`.

regenerate_url_on_item_update.description: Change an item's URL when its name or title changes. Defaults to `false`.

auto_redirect_on_url_change.description: Change redirection when an item's URL changes. Defaults to `false`.

redirects.description: The rows of `redirects`, without paging details. Read-only here: use the redirect calls to add, change or delete them.

SeoUrlSettingsInput.description: The two settings of `url_settings` you can write. `redirects` is not one of them.

regenerate_url_on_item_update.description: Change an item's URL when its name or title changes. Defaults to `false`.

auto_redirect_on_url_change.description: Change redirection when an item's URL changes. Defaults to `false`.

SeoDocumentRootRows.description: The rows of `document_root`, without paging details.

config_key.description: The file's key, assigned by the store, such as `seo-upload-6`. Pass it as `config_key` in a path. It is not the file name.

file_name.description: The name of the uploaded file.

file_path.description: The file's path: `seo-upload/` followed by the file name.

id.description: The redirect's id, assigned by the store. Pass it as `redirect_id` in a path.

source_url.description: The URL that is redirected, such as `/old-page`. No two redirects can have the same `source_url`.

destination_url.description: The URL the redirect goes to.

source_url.description: Required. A valid URL that no other redirect has.

destination_url.description: Required. A valid URL that does not resolve to the same URL as `source_url`.

SeoRedirectUpdate.description: Send only the fields that change.

destination_url.description: The new URL the redirect goes to.

total.description: The number of rows in the collection.

limit.description: The page size the store applied. At most `100`.

offset.description: The number of rows skipped before this page.

SeoGroupMeta.description: One entry per part of the configuration. Only [Get SEO configuration](/api-reference/seo-configuration/get-seo-configuration), [Update SEO configuration](/api-reference/seo-configuration/update-seo-configuration) and [Replace SEO configuration sections](/api-reference/seo-configuration/replace-seo-configuration-sections) return it.

kind.description: `setting` for the three settings sections, `collection` for `document_root` and `redirects`.

writable.description: `true` for the three settings sections. `false` for `document_root` and `redirects`, even though you can add and delete their rows.

href.description: The part's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/seo_configuration/url_settings`.

redirects.description: Only in the `url_settings` entry: the entry for `redirects`.

SeoFieldMetadata.description: Has the same nesting as the settings, with a `SeoFieldMetadataEntry` in place of each value.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes: `string`, `enum`, `enum_list`, `boolean` or `text`.

description.description: What the field does.

required.description: Whether the field must have a value.

writable.description: Whether a write can set the field.

default.description: The field's default value.

allowed_values.description: The values the field accepts, for an `enum` or `enum_list` field.

labels.description: A label for each allowed value, for an `enum` field.

requires.description: The field this one depends on, such as `header.enabled`.

SeoConfigurationError.description: The error from the redirect and document root writes, and from writes to `/seo_configuration`.

code.description: The HTTP status.

error.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `not_found`, `duplicate` or `malformed_json`.

errors.description: One entry per rejected field, when the error is about a field.

field.description: The field that was rejected.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `required`, `invalid_url` or `duplicate`.

provided.description: The rejected value, when the store includes it.

SeoConfigurationSectionError.description: The error from `/seo_configuration/{section}`, and from reads of the redirects and the document root, such as a `redirect_id` that no redirect has or a `limit` that is not accepted.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request` or `not_found`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field or paging value. Empty when the error is not about a value you sent.

field.description: The field that was rejected, such as `global_store_settings.title_separator`. `null` for a rejected paging value.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field`, `invalid_enum`, `invalid_boolean` or `invalid_integer`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the store includes it.

request_id.description: A value that identifies this request.

ShippingSettings.description: The seven shipping settings. None of them has a path of its own.

default_shipping_profile.description: The default shipping profile, as the profile's `{id, name}` record, or `null` for `No Shipping`.

enable_shipping_default_tax.description: `true` turns on the default tax for shipping. Changing it changes no other field.

default_delivery_profile.description: The default delivery profile, as the profile's `{id, name}` record, or `null` for `No Shipping`.

enable_delivery_default_tax.description: `true` turns on the default tax for delivery.

shipping_tax_profile.description: The shipping tax profile, as the profile's `{id, name}` record, or `null` for `No Tax`.

enable_shipping_class.description: `true` turns on shipping classes. Turning it off also turns `enable_flat_view_class` off.

enable_flat_view_class.description: Depends on `enable_shipping_class`: it stays `false` while `enable_shipping_class` is `false`, even when you write `true`.

ShippingSettingsProfile.description: The profile a profile field points at.

id.description: The profile's `id`. Send it in a write to choose this profile.

name.description: The profile's name.

ShippingSettingsInput.description: The fields to change. Every field is optional; send only the ones that change.

default_shipping_profile.description: The profile to choose as the default shipping profile.

enable_shipping_default_tax.description: `true` turns on the default tax for shipping. Changing it changes no other field. A string is rejected with `400`.

default_delivery_profile.description: The profile to choose as the default delivery profile.

enable_delivery_default_tax.description: `true` turns on the default tax for delivery. A string is rejected with `400`.

shipping_tax_profile.description: The profile to choose as the shipping tax profile.

enable_shipping_class.description: `true` turns on shipping classes. Turning it off also turns `enable_flat_view_class` off. When you turn it back on, write `enable_flat_view_class` as well. A string is rejected with `400`.

enable_flat_view_class.description: Depends on `enable_shipping_class`: it stays `false` while `enable_shipping_class` is `false`, even when you write `true`. A string is rejected with `400`.

ShippingSettingsProfileInput.description: The profile to choose, by its `id`. The profile `id`s you can send are in the field's `options` under `field_metadata`. A profile `id` that none of the `options` has is rejected with `400 invalid_reference`, and a bare name string with `400` and `id must be an integer`. A `{"code": …}` record is looked up by code, and is rejected with `400 invalid_reference` when no profile matches.

anyOf.description: The profile's `id` as a numeric string, such as `"1"`. A name is rejected.
A record with the profile's `id`. The `{id, name}` record a read returns is accepted as it is.

id.description: The profile's `id`.

anyOf.description: A record with the profile's name.

name.description: The profile's name.

ShippingSettingsAreaMeta.description: What the settings group is and whether you can write it. There is no `href`.

kind.description: The kind of group: `setting`.

writable.description: Whether you can write these settings: `true`.

ShippingSettingsFieldMetadata.description: Describes each of the seven fields, keyed by field name. Returned only when you send `field_metadata=true`.

ShippingSettingsFieldOption.description: One profile you can choose for a profile field.

id.description: The profile's `id`. Send it in a write to choose this profile. `null` on the `No Shipping` or `No Tax` option: send `null` to choose it.

name.description: The profile's name, or `No Shipping` or `No Tax`.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes: `reference` for the three profile fields, `boolean` for the other four.

description.description: What the field does.

writable.description: Whether a write can set the field.

key_path.description: Where the field sits in the body, such as `shipping_settings.enable_shipping_class`.

default.description: The field's default value. Only on the four boolean fields.

depends_on.description: Only on `enable_flat_view_class`: `enable_shipping_class`, the field it depends on.

nullable.description: Whether the field can be `null`. Only on the three profile fields, where it is `true`.

references.description: Only on the three profile fields: the kind of profile the field points at. `shipping_profile` on `default_shipping_profile` and `default_delivery_profile`, `custom_tax_profile` on `shipping_tax_profile`.

accepts.description: Only on the three profile fields: `id` and `name`, and also `code` on `shipping_tax_profile`. A bare name string is still rejected with `400`: send `{"name": …}` or the profile's `id` instead.

write_key.description: Only on the three profile fields: `id`.

options.description: Only on the three profile fields: the profiles you can choose, starting with the `No Shipping` or `No Tax` option, whose `id` is `null`. Send an option's `id` to choose that profile.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `invalid_reference`, `not_found` or `method_not_allowed`.

message.description: What was wrong, such as `shipping_settings body missing`.

details.description: Extra detail about the error, or an empty list.

SiteSettings.description: All eight sections, as [Get site settings](/api-reference/site-settings/get-site-settings) returns them. In a write, send only the sections and fields that change.

SiteSettingsRegion.description: A country or a state. A read returns this record; a write can send the country's or state's `id`, `code` or `name` alone instead.

id.description: The country's or state's `id`.

code.description: The country's or state's code, such as `AU` or `NSW`.

name.description: The country's or state's name, such as `Australia` or `New South Wales`.

SiteSettingsAdministration.description: Units of measure, price precision, the default country and state, error pages, CAPTCHA and address suggestions.

page_404.description: The URL of the page shown when a page is not found. It must be the URL of an existing page, or empty for the system-defined page: anything else is rejected with `400 invalid_page`.

page_403.description: The URL of the page shown when access is forbidden, or `null`.

default_country.description: The default country for new records. A write can send the country's `id`, `code` or `name` alone, or the whole record.

default_state.description: The default state for new records. A write can send the state's `id`, `code` or `name` alone, or the whole record. A state `id` that matches no state is rejected with `400 invalid_reference`.

max_precision.description: The number of decimal places for prices and amounts. `0` or `10` is rejected with `400 out_of_range`.

unit_length.description: The unit of length. A value outside this list is rejected with `400 invalid_enum`.

ecommerce_enabled.description: Turn the storefront's commerce features on or off.

SiteSettingsCaptcha.description: CAPTCHA protection for the store's forms.

enabled.description: Protect forms with a CAPTCHA.

type.description: The CAPTCHA provider, such as `re_captcha`.

private_key.description: The CAPTCHA secret key, or `null`. Reads back as `***` once set. Send a new value to change it, or leave it out to keep it.

public_key_v3.description: The reCAPTCHA v3 site key, or `null`.

private_key_v3.description: The reCAPTCHA v3 secret key, or `null`. Reads back as `***` once set. Send a new value to change it, or leave it out to keep it.

public_key_turnstile.description: Returned on reads, as text or `null`. `field_metadata` has no entry for it.

private_key_turnstile.description: Returned on reads, as text or `null`. `field_metadata` has no entry for it.

minimum_score.description: The reCAPTCHA v3 minimum passing score, such as `0.5`. A read returns a number, although `field_metadata` types it `string`.

SiteSettingsAutoSuggest.description: Address and suburb suggestions as the user types.

suburbs_cities.description: Suggest suburbs and cities as the user types.

enabled.description: Suggest addresses as the user types.

validate.description: Validate the address the user chooses.

enabled.description: Turn the site-wide brand palette on or off.

palette_name.description: The name of the default colour palette.

SiteSettingsBrandColors.description: Six colour roles, each a hex colour such as `#1a1a1a`. A value that is not a colour is rejected with `400 invalid_color`.

SiteSettingsDateTime.description: Date and time formats and time zones for the admin area, emails and the storefront.

email.description: The date and time settings used in emails.

user.description: The date and time settings for the storefront.

hide_time_zone.description: Hide the time zone label on the storefront.

separate_time_zone_for_email.description: Use a separate time zone for emails. `field_metadata` lists it as writable, but a read does not return it.

separate_time_zone_for_user.description: Use a separate time zone for the storefront. `field_metadata` lists it as writable, but a read does not return it.

SiteSettingsAdminDateTime.description: The admin area's date and time settings.

time_zone.description: The time zone, such as `Australia/Adelaide`. `field_metadata` lists the accepted values in `enums.time_zone.values`.

first_day_of_week.description: The first day shown in calendars.

SiteSettingsSeparableDateTime.description: The date and time settings for emails or for the storefront.

separate.description: Returned on reads. `field_metadata` has no entry for it. To give emails or the storefront their own time zone, send `separate_time_zone_for_email` or `separate_time_zone_for_user` on `date_time`.

time_zone.description: The time zone, such as `Australia/Adelaide`. `field_metadata` lists the accepted values in `enums.time_zone.values`.

SiteSettingsDomainSettings.description: The store's web address, HTTPS, maintenance mode, site lock, domain aliases and SSL files.

website_address.description: The public base URL of the store, such as `https://your-store.example.com/`.

aliases.description: The store's domain aliases. Read-only here: manage them through `/api/v4/admin/aliases`. A write that names only `aliases` is rejected with `400 unknown_field`.

SiteSettingsMaintenance.description: Whether the storefront is closed for maintenance, and what it shows.

enabled.description: Put the storefront into maintenance mode.

message.description: The message shown during maintenance.

SiteSettingsSecurityCode.description: The site lock: a code visitors must enter to view the site.

enabled.description: Require a code to view the site.

code.description: The code visitors must enter, or `null`. Reads back as `***` once set. Send a new value to change it, or leave it out to keep it.

number_only.description: Allow only digits in the code.

SiteSettingsSsl.description: The SSL private key and certificate. A read returns `key_file` and `certificate_file`; a write sends `key_file_base64` and `certificate_file_base64` instead.

key_file_base64.description: The private key as a base64 PEM. The store checks it and never returns it. Send it with `certificate_file_base64`.

certificate_file_base64.description: The certificate as a base64 PEM. The store checks it and never returns it. Send it with `key_file_base64`.

SiteSettingsSslKeyFile.description: What is stored for the private key. The key itself is never returned.

uploaded.description: Whether a key file is stored.

SiteSettingsSslCertificateFile.description: What is stored for the certificate.

uploaded.description: Whether a certificate file is stored.

SiteSettingsEmailSettings.description: The provider the store sends email through, and each provider's settings.

service_provider.description: The provider the store sends email through.

available.description: The providers you can choose. Read-only.

gmail.description: Gmail. Connect it through its interactive flow, not through this API.

office365.description: Office 365. Connect it through its interactive flow, not through this API.

SiteSettingsEmailProvider.description: A provider the store can send email through.

key.description: The provider's key: the value `service_provider` takes.

type.description: `direct`, or `oauth` for a provider you connect through `connect_url`.

connect_url.description: The path that starts the provider's connect flow. Only on `oauth` providers.
The path that starts the connect flow, such as `/setting/authorizeGmail`. Read-only.

SiteSettingsSmtp.description: The SMTP server the store sends through, and the sender it uses.

SiteSettingsSmtpAuthentication.description: How the store signs in to the SMTP server.

enabled.description: Use SMTP authentication.

password.description: The SMTP password. Reads back as `***` once set. Send a new value to change it, or leave it out to keep it.

SiteSettingsSendGrid.description: The SendGrid account the store sends through, and the sender it uses.

api_key.description: The SendGrid API key. Reads back as `***` once set. Send a new value to change it, or leave it out to keep it.

different.description: Send replies to a different address from the sender's.

SiteSettingsDefaultDomain.description: One of the platform's sending domains, and the sender used on it.

configure.description: Use custom sender details for this domain.

sender_name.description: The sender's display name on this domain.

email_prefix.description: The part of the sender address before `@` and the domain.

SiteSettingsFavicon.description: The favicon. A read returns `enabled` and `image`; a write sends `image_base64` or `remove`.

enabled.description: `true` when a favicon is set. Read-only: the store sets it from whether an image is stored.

image.description: The stored favicon, or `null` when none is set.

image_base64.description: A new favicon as a data URI, such as `data:image/png;base64,...`: a transparent PNG or JPEG of up to 10 KB and at most 256 x 256 pixels.

remove.description: Send `true` to remove the current favicon.

SiteSettingsStoreLogo.description: The store logo. A read returns `image`; a write sends `image_base64`.

image_base64.description: A new logo as a data URI, such as `data:image/png;base64,...`: a PNG or JPEG of up to 200 KB.

remove.description: Listed in `field_metadata`, but `remove: true` is rejected with `400`: the logo can only be replaced with a new `image_base64`.

SiteSettingsMediaImage.description: A stored image and where it is served from.

url.description: The public URL of the image.

content_type.description: The image's media type, such as `image/png`.

size_bytes.description: The file size in bytes, or `null`.

SiteSettingsStoreDetails.description: The business's name, contact email, address, phone numbers and ABN. `group_meta` marks it `kind: "resource"`, and every field is writable.

company_name.description: The registered store or business name. Marked `required` in `field_metadata`; a write that leaves it out keeps the stored value.

email.description: The store's main contact email. A value that is not an email address is rejected with `400 invalid_email`. Marked `required` in `field_metadata`.

abn.description: The Australian Business Number, or a local tax number. It must be 11 digits, with spaces allowed: anything else is rejected with `400 invalid_abn`.

state.description: The state. A write can send the state's `id`, `code` or `name` alone, or the whole record.

country.description: The country. A write can send the country's `id`, `code` or `name` alone, or the whole record.

SiteSettingsGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. Only [Get site settings](/api-reference/site-settings/get-site-settings) and [Update site settings](/api-reference/site-settings/update-site-settings) return it.

kind.description: What the section is: `media` for `favicon` and `store_logo`, `resource` for `store_details`, and `setting` for the other five.

writable.description: Whether you can write to the section. `true` for all eight.

href.description: The section's own path, such as `/api/v4/admin/settings/site_settings/brand_kit`.

SiteSettingsFieldMetadata.description: Each section is nested like the settings, with a `SiteSettingsFieldMetadataEntry` for each field. A field entry always has `writable`; a block of entries does not. The match with a read is not exact: some entries name a field a read never returns, such as `favicon.image_base64`, and some fields a read returns have no entry, such as `date_time.email.separate`. On `/site_settings` it covers all eight sections, keyed by section, and an `enums` key beside them lists the `time_zone` and `locale` values. On `/site_settings/{section}` it holds the section's own name, and for `date_time` an `enums` key that lists the `time_zone` values. Each list under `enums` has `values`, the accepted values, and `labels`, a display name for each value.

description.description: What the field holds or does.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes: `boolean`, `string`, `integer`, `enum`, `object` or `array`.

writable.description: Whether a write can set the field.

read_only.description: `true` when a write cannot set the field.

write_only.description: `true` on a field that a read never returns, such as `domain_settings.ssl.key_file_base64`.

secret.description: `true` on a secret field. A read returns it as `***` once it is set, except `domain_settings.ssl.key_file_base64`, which a read never returns.

note.description: Extra guidance, such as how to keep a secret field's stored value.

allowed_values.description: The values the field accepts, for an `enum` field.

enum_ref.description: The key under `enums` that lists the field's accepted values, such as `time_zone`.

min.description: The lowest value, for an `integer` field.

max.description: The highest value, for an `integer` field.

shape.description: The record a read returns, such as `{id,code,name}`.

accepts.description: The forms a write accepts, such as `id | code | name | object`.

accepts_human_value.description: `true` on the country and state fields, whose `accepts` lists `code` and `name`.

media.description: `true` on an upload field, such as `image_base64`.

key_path.description: The field's full path, such as `site_settings.brand_kit.palette_name`.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `not_found` or `unsupported_media_type`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field. Empty when the error is not about a field.

field.description: The field that was rejected.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `unknown_field`, `unknown_section` or `invalid_boolean`.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

id.description: The shipping method's id, assigned by the store. Pass it as `shipping_method_id` in a path.

name.description: Unique across the store's methods.

is_default.description: `true` on the one default method. Only `PUT /admin/shipping_methods/{shipping_method_id}/default` changes it.

name.description: Required. At most 100 characters, and no other method may have the same name.

type.description: The field's value type: `integer` for `id`, `string` for `name` and `boolean` for `is_default`.

writable.description: Whether a write can set this field. `true` only for `name`.

required.description: Whether a write must send this field. Only `name` has it, set to `true`.

max_length.description: The longest value accepted. Only `name` has it, set to `100`.

description.description: What the field holds.

ShippingMethodsFieldMetadata.description: Describes each field, keyed by field name. Returned only when you send `field_metadata=true`.

total.description: The number of shipping methods in the store.

limit.description: The page size the store applied. At most `20`.

offset.description: The number of rows skipped before this page.

count.description: The number of rows on this page.

previous_page.description: The previous page, or `null` on the first page.

next_page.description: The next page, or `null` on the last page. Check `has_next` before you request it.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `not_found` or `conflict`.

details.description: Extra detail, or an empty list. On some errors the first entry's `code` gives the reason: `duplicate`, `default_in_use` or `unknown_parameter`.

id.description: The shipping class's `id`, assigned by the store. Pass it as `shipping_class_id` in a path.

name.description: Unique across the store's shipping classes. At most 50 characters.

description.description: At most 100 characters. `null` when the last create or update left it out.

name.description: Required. At most 50 characters, and no other class may have the same name.
