last_updated_on.description: When the field last changed. `sort=updated` sorts by it.

has_max_length.description: Whether the field has a maximum length.

OrderCustomField.description: An order custom field with all 21 keys, as [Retrieve an order custom field](/api-reference/order-custom-fields/retrieve-an-order-custom-field) returns it.

id.description: The order custom field's `id`, assigned by the store. Pass it as `order_custom_field_id` in a path.

field_type.description: The field's type, one of the ten values `filterBy` takes. `sort=type` sorts by it.

label.description: The field's label, at most 500 characters. `sort=label` sorts by it.

name.description: The field's name. `sort=name` sorts by it.

is_active.description: Whether the field is active. `sort=isActive` sorts by it.

order_no.description: An integer that `sort=orderNo` sorts by, or `null`.

created_on.description: When the field was created. `sort=created` sorts by it.

last_updated_on.description: When the field last changed. `sort=updated` sorts by it.

has_max_length.description: Whether the field has a maximum length.

hover_text.description: The field's hover text, at most 100 characters, or `null`.

placeholder.description: The field's placeholder text, at most 100 characters, or `null`.

default_value.description: The field's default value, at most 500 characters, or `null`.

html_class.description: The field's HTML class, at most 100 characters, or `null`.

options.description: The choices of a `single.select.radio`, `single.select.dropdown`, `multi.select.checkbox` or `multi.select.list` field, each a string. The list can be empty.

is_allowed_for_shipping.description: Whether the field is allowed for shipping. `field_metadata` does not describe it.

is_allowed_for_delivery.description: Whether the field is allowed for delivery. `field_metadata` does not describe it.

is_allowed_for_store_pickup.description: Whether the field is allowed for store pickup. `field_metadata` does not describe it.

is_allowed_for_pre_order.description: Whether the field is allowed for pre-orders. `field_metadata` does not describe it.

total.description: The number of order custom fields that match your request: all of them, or those of the `filterBy` type.

limit.description: The page size the store applied: the `limit` you sent, at most `20`, or `20` when you send none.

offset.description: The number of fields skipped before this page.

count.description: The number of fields on this page.

current_page.description: The number of this page: `1` at `offset=0`, and also `1` when no field matches. For an `offset` past the last field, the number of the last page.

total_pages.description: `total` divided by `limit`, rounded up. `0` when no field matches.

has_next.description: Whether a page comes after this one.

has_previous.description: Whether a page comes before this one. `false` on the first page, and also `false` for an `offset` past the last field.

previous_page.description: The previous page, or `null` on the first page.

next_page.description: The next page, or `null` on the last page.

OrderCustomFieldGroupMeta.description: Returned only by [List order custom fields](/api-reference/order-custom-fields/list-order-custom-fields), with one entry.

kind.description: `resource` for this list.

writable.description: `false`: you cannot create, change or delete order custom fields through the API.

OrderCustomFieldMetadata.description: Describes 18 order custom field keys, one entry per key name. Returned only when you send `field_metadata=true` or `1`. The `field_type` entry lists the ten field types and `input_format` the six input formats; `options` applies to the four select types and `rate_id` to `delivery` fields. The `label`, `hover_text`, `placeholder`, `default_value` and `html_class` entries give their maximum lengths. It describes `rate_id`, which neither a listing nor [Retrieve an order custom field](/api-reference/order-custom-fields/retrieve-an-order-custom-field) returns, and leaves out the four `is_allowed_for_*` keys that a retrieved field has.

OrderCustomFieldMetadataEntry.description: Describes one key. Every entry has `type`; the other keys differ from entry to entry.

type.description: The kind of value the key holds.

values.description: The allowed values, such as the ten field types on the `field_type` entry.

read_only.description: `true` on the entries for the field's `id`, `name`, `created_on` and `last_updated_on`.

OrderCustomFieldTimeslotInput.description: Send these keys at the top level of the body, not wrapped in a key. Other keys, such as `field_name`, are accepted with any value.

selected_date.description: Required. A real date written `dd/MM/yyyy`, such as `25/10/2026`; a date in the past is accepted. `31/02/2026`, `2026-10-25`, `5/1/2026`, a number and a date with spaces around it are rejected with `400`.

weekday_id.description: A whole number. Its range is not checked: `0`, `9` and `-3` are all accepted.

start_hour.description: The timeslot's start hour, a whole number from `0` to `23`. Required when `order_limit` is above `0`.

end_hour.description: The timeslot's end hour, a whole number from `0` to `23`. Required when `order_limit` is above `0`. It is not checked against `start_hour`.

order_limit.description: A whole number. `0` returns `valid: false`; a negative number, or no `order_limit`, returns `valid: true`. Above `0`, send `start_hour` and `end_hour` too.

valid.description: `true` when the timeslot is available, `false` when it is fully booked.

message.description: `Timeslot available` when `valid` is `true`, and `Timeslot fully booked` when it is `false`.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `not_found` or `method_not_allowed`.

message.description: What went wrong, such as `Field not found` or `field_metadata must be true/false or 0/1`.

details.description: One entry per rejected body key or query parameter. Empty on a `404` or a `405`.

field.description: The body key or query parameter that was rejected.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `required`, `invalid_date`, `invalid_type`, `out_of_range`, `invalid_value`, `invalid_enum`, `invalid_integer` or `invalid_boolean`.

message.description: `null` when `limit`, `offset`, `page` or `field_metadata` was rejected.

value.description: The value you sent. Left out when the reason is `required`.

customer_id.description: The customer's `internal_id`, as you sent it to [Add a product to a cart](/api-reference/carts/add-a-product-to-a-cart). Only that call's response shows it: [Retrieve a cart](/api-reference/carts/retrieve-a-cart) and [Update a cart item](/api-reference/carts/update-a-cart-item) return `null`.

session_id.description: The cart's `session_id`. Pass it as the `session_id` path parameter in the other cart calls.

currency_code.description: The currency of the cart's amounts, such as `AUD`.

delivery_type.description: The cart's delivery type, such as `shipping`.

items.description: The cart's items. Adding a product that is already in the cart raises that item's `quantity` instead of adding an entry.

subtotal.description: The sum of each item's `quantity` times its `pricing.unit_price`. A discount shows in `discount`, not here.

handling_tax.description: Tax on the handling fee. It depends on `shipping_address.country_code`, and is `0.0` when you sent no shipping address.

shipping_tax.description: Tax on shipping. It depends on `shipping_address.country_code`, and is `0.0` when you sent no shipping address.

id.description: The cart item's `id`. Pass it as `cart_item_id` to update or remove the item. The store numbers cart items across all carts, so a cart's first item can have any `id`.

quantity.description: How many of the product the cart holds.

unit_price.description: The price of one unit. `totals.subtotal` adds up `quantity` times this for every item.

id.description: The product's `id`, which you sent as `product_id`.

available_stock.description: The product's stock, not the item's `quantity`.

kind.description: `resource`.

writable.description: `true`.

href.description: `/api/v4/carts/{sessionId}`, with `{sessionId}` left as written rather than your cart's `session_id`.

sessionId.description: The value to use as the cart's `session_id`. Only this call spells the field `sessionId`, in both the request body and the response.

quantity.description: Required. How many to add. If the product is already in the cart, this raises that item's `quantity`.

customer_id.description: Required. The customer's `internal_id`. The customer's `customer_id` is rejected with `400` and the message `No Customer Found`.

session_id.description: The name you choose for the cart. Without it, the store uses your HTTP session's `JSESSIONID`, and `cart.session_id` in the response shows it.

shipping_address.description: Sets the cart's shipping taxes. It never reaches an order made from the cart.

CartItemInput.description: Send these fields at the top level of the body.

cart_item_id.description: Required. The cart item's `id`, from `items[].id`. Without it the call is rejected with `400` and the message `f:cart_item_id not found`.

quantity.description: Required. The item's new quantity. `0` is rejected with `400`, and a body without `quantity` returns `500`.

shipping_address.description: Sets the cart's shipping taxes. An order you create with the same `JSESSIONID` cookie gets this address.

billing_address.description: An order you create with the same `JSESSIONID` cookie gets this address.

CartItemUpdateInput.description: Send these fields at the top level of the body. Do not send `customer_id`: it returns `500`, although the new `quantity` is saved.

address_line1.description: The first address line. Spelled without an underscore before the `1`, unlike `address_line_1` in an order's address.

country_code.description: A country code, such as `AU`. In `shipping_address`, it decides the cart's `shipping.shipping_tax` and `shipping.handling_tax`.

CartAddressInput.description: The store does not check any field, and accepts `{}`. No cart response returns the address.

sessionId.description: A value to get back as `sessionId`. `null` or `""` returns your HTTP session's `JSESSIONID` instead: the cookie your client sends, or a new value when it sends none.

CartSessionInput.description: Send `{}` to get back the `session_id` from the path. A `session_id` key is ignored.

customer_id.description: Required. The customer's `customer_id`, not the `internal_id` that [Add a product to a cart](/api-reference/carts/add-a-product-to-a-cart) takes.

transaction_no.description: A transaction number to store on the order. The response shows `transaction_no` as `null`.

CartOrderInput.description: Send these fields at the top level of the body.

order_id.description: The new order's `order_id`, assigned by the store.

internal_id.description: The order's `internal_id`. The customer's `internal_id` is in `customer_summary.internal_id`.

transaction_no.description: `null` in this response, even when you sent `transaction_no`. The order stores the value you sent.

order_status.description: `in_progress` on an order made from a cart.

payment_status.description: `unpaid` on an order made from a cart.

shipping_tax.description: Tax on shipping. It follows the order's addresses, not the cart's `shipping.shipping_tax`.

order_channel.description: `null` on an order made from a cart.

customer_summary.description: The customer the order belongs to, with both the customer's `customer_id` and `internal_id`.

payments.description: The order's payments. When you send `"payment_gateway": "PIS"` or leave `payment_gateway` out, this holds one `PIS` payment with `status` `awaiting`.

external_reference_order_id.description: `null` on an order made from a cart.

external_reference_store_id.description: `null` on an order made from a cart.

external_reference_order_no.description: `null` on an order made from a cart.

external_reference_status.description: `null` on an order made from a cart.

external_reference_url.description: `null` on an order made from a cart.

customer_id.description: The customer's `customer_id`: the number [Create an order from a cart](/api-reference/carts/create-an-order-from-a-cart) takes.

internal_id.description: The customer's `internal_id`: the number [Add a product to a cart](/api-reference/carts/add-a-product-to-a-cart) takes.

product_id.description: The product's `id`, as in the cart item's `product.id`.

id.description: The payment's `id`.

payment_method.description: `PIS` when you send `"payment_gateway": "PIS"` or leave `payment_gateway` out.

gateway_code.description: `PIS` when you send `"payment_gateway": "PIS"` or leave `payment_gateway` out.

id.description: The address's `id`.

CartOrderAddress.description: The customer's saved address, unless you sent addresses to [Update a cart item](/api-reference/carts/update-a-cart-item) with the same `JSESSIONID` cookie as [Create an order from a cart](/api-reference/carts/create-an-order-from-a-cart): then the address that update sent. Addresses you send to [Add a product to a cart](/api-reference/carts/add-a-product-to-a-cart) never appear here.

id.description: The country's or state's `id`.

name.description: Such as `Australia`.

code.description: Such as `AU`.

CartReference.description: A country or a state. A state is `{}` when the address has none.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `not_found` or `internal_error`.

message.description: What went wrong, such as `Your shopping cart is empty`. Some messages start with `f:`, such as `f:cart item not found`.

details.description: An empty list.

Category.description: A category: six sections and eight read-only fields. A listing entry, a category read and the response to a create, replace or update have the same fields.

id.description: The category's `id`, assigned by the store. Pass it as `category_id` in a path.

disposable.description: A flag the store sets. You cannot write it.

in_trash.description: `true` after you delete the category, which moves it to the trash.

parent_in_trash.description: `false` even when the parent category is in the trash. To check the parent, retrieve it and read its `in_trash`.

created_by.description: Identifies who created the category, such as an email address. It can be `""`.

last_updated_on.description: When the category last changed. On a new category it equals `created_on`. The listing puts the most recent first unless you send `sort`.

CategorySection.description: Holds only the section named in the path.

CategoryReference.description: A record the category links to, such as its parent category, as `{id, name}`, or `null` when none is set. In a write, send only the record's `id`.

id.description: The linked record's `id`, such as the parent category's `id`.

name.description: The linked record's name. Returned in responses.

CategoryGeneral.description: The category's name, title, `sku`, `url`, heading, parent, filter profile, layout and summary.

name.description: The category's name. A create rejects a name that a top-level category has, in any letter case.

sku.description: The category's SKU. When you create the category without one, the store generates `CATEGORY-` followed by 11 hexadecimal characters.

url.description: The category's `url`, such as `seasonal-produce`. When you create the category without one, the store makes it from the name, adding a suffix such as `-1` when another category has the same name. A `PUT` that renames the category leaves it as it was.

parent_category.description: The parent category as `{id, name}`, or `null` for a top-level category.

filter_profile.description: The category's filter profile, which comes from the filter plugin. `null` on a store without the plugin.

CategoryDescription.description: The category's description. Responses and writes use the same field.

CategoryImagesMedia.description: The URLs of the category's two images. To upload an image, send `images_media.image` or `images_media.background_image` in a write.

image_url.description: The category image's URL, ending in the file name you uploaded, or `""` when no image is set.

background_image_url.description: The background image's URL, in a `background/` folder and ending in the file name you uploaded, or `""` when no background image is set.

CategorySelectedCustomers.description: The customers and groups the category is available to when `available_for` is `selected`.

customers.description: Each customer as `{id, name}`. Empty on a new category.

groups.description: Each group as `{id, name}`. Empty on a new category.

CategoryAvailabilityVisibility.description: Whether the category is available and visible, to whom and when, with its password and sorting settings.

available.description: Whether the category is available. `true` on a new category.

visible.description: Whether the category is visible. `true` on a new category.

available_for.description: Who the category is available to: `everyone`, `customer` or `selected`. With `selected`, it is available to the customers and groups in `selected_customers`. `everyone` on a new category.

available_on_date_range.description: Turns on the date range set by `available_from_date` and `available_to_date`. `false` on a new category.

available_from_date.description: The start of the date range, such as `2026-11-02T00:00:00Z`, or `null`.

available_to_date.description: The end of the date range, such as `2026-11-20T00:00:00Z`, or `null`.

password_protected.description: Whether the category is password protected. `false` on a new category. The password itself is never returned.

custom_sorting.description: Turns custom sorting on for the category. `false` on a new category.

default_sorting.description: The category's default sort order: `alpha_asc`, `alpha_desc`, `price_desc`, `price_asc`, `created_asc` or `created_desc`. `null` on a new category.

disable_tracking.description: Turns tracking off for the category. `false` on a new category.

CategoryTaxShipping.description: The category's tax and shipping settings. Responses and writes use the same fields. A `PUT` sets a `tax_profile` or `shipping_profile` it leaves out to `null`, whether or not it sends this section; clearing the shipping profile sets `enable_shipping` to `false`.

tax_exempt.description: Whether the category is tax exempt. `false` on a new category.

tax_profile.description: The tax profile as `{id, name}`, or `null`. Send `{"id": ...}` to set it; a `name` beside the `id` is ignored.

tax_message.description: A message about tax, such as `Prices include GST`. `""` on a new category.

show_price_with_tax.description: Whether prices show with tax. `true` on a new category.

prices_entered_with_tax.description: Whether prices are entered with tax. `false` on a new category.

base_price_rounding.description: How the base price is rounded. `nearest` on a new category.

enable_shipping.description: Whether shipping is on. `false` on a new category. Setting a `shipping_profile` sets it to `true`, and setting it to `false` clears `shipping_profile`, even a profile sent in the same body.

shipping_profile.description: The shipping profile as `{id, name}`, or `null`. Send `{"id": ...}` to set it, which also sets `enable_shipping` to `true`.

CategoryProduct.description: A product assigned to the category.

id.description: The product's `id`.

name.description: The product's name.

CategoryAssignProducts.description: The products assigned to the category.

products.description: Each product as `{id, name, sku}`. Empty on a new category unless you assign products. A product can be in several categories.

CategoryGroupMeta.description: One entry per section. The listing, a category read, and the responses to create, replace and update return it; a section read or update does not.

kind.description: `section` for every entry.

writable.description: `true` for every entry.

href.description: The section's path, such as `/api/v4/admin/categories/{id}/general`. `{id}` is literal text: put the category's `id` in its place before you call the path.

CategoryPagination.description: Paging details for the listing. With an `offset` at or past `total`, `count` is `0` and `current_page` shows the last page, while `has_previous` shows `false` and `previous_page` is `null`.

total.description: The number of categories outside the trash that match your filters.

limit.description: The page size applied: the `limit` you sent, capped at `20`, or `20`.

offset.description: The number of categories skipped before this page.

count.description: The number of categories on this page.

current_page.description: The page number: `offset` divided by `limit`, rounded down, plus `1`, but never more than `total_pages`. It shows `1` when no category matches.

has_previous.description: `true` when `offset` is above `0`, except that it shows `false` when `offset` is at or past `total`.

previous_page.description: The full URL of the previous page, or `null` when there is none. It sets `limit` and an `offset` that never goes below `0`, and repeats every other query parameter you sent except `page`, even `field_metadata` and parameters the listing ignores.

next_page.description: The full URL of the next page, or `null` on the last page. It sets `limit` and the next `offset`, and repeats every other query parameter you sent except `page`, even `field_metadata` and parameters the listing ignores.

CategoryFieldMetadata.description: Describes every field of a category. Returned only when you send `field_metadata=true`. Each of the eight read-only fields has one entry, and each section is an object of entries keyed by field name; `availability_visibility.selected_customers` nests one level further, with `customers` and `groups`. The `images_media.image` and `images_media.background_image` entries describe a base64 `data:` URI string, but a write must send a `{filename, base64}` object: a `data:` URI string returns `500`. The `general.url` entry says a replace without `url` makes it from the name, but a `PUT` that renames a category without `url` leaves the `url` as it was.

general.description: One entry per field of `general`, keyed by field name.

description.description: One entry per field of `description`, keyed by field name.

images_media.description: One entry per field of `images_media`, keyed by field name.

availability_visibility.description: One entry per field of `availability_visibility`, keyed by field name.

tax_shipping.description: One entry per field of `tax_shipping`, keyed by field name.

assign_products.description: One entry per field of `assign_products`, keyed by field name.

CategoryFieldMetadataEntry.description: Describes one field. Every entry has `type`, `read_only` and `key_path`; the other keys appear on some entries only.

type.description: The field's value type.

read_only.description: `true` when you cannot write the field: the eight read-only fields, `general.filter_profile`, `images_media.image_url` and `images_media.background_image_url`.

key_path.description: Where the field sits in a category.

required.description: On a field you can write, whether a write must send it.

min_length.description: The shortest value accepted, such as `2` for `general.name`.

max_length.description: The longest value accepted: `255` for `general.name` and `general.url`, `200` for `general.title` and `general.heading`, and `500` for `general.summary`.

values.description: The values the field accepts, on a field that takes only a fixed list.

note.description: A remark about the field, such as the one on `last_updated_by`.

write_only.description: `true` on the three fields a write accepts but no response returns: `images_media.image`, `images_media.background_image` and `availability_visibility.password`.

CategoryWriteBody.description: Every write wraps its sections in `category`.

CategoryInput.description: Group the fields by section. An unknown key beside the sections is rejected with `400` (`<key>: is not a recognised category field`), except in a section update, which reads only the section named in its path and ignores the rest. You cannot change the category's `id`: an `id` beside the sections is ignored, and so is a key beside `category`.

CategoryGeneralInput.description: The `general` fields you can write. Leave `filter_profile` out or send `null`: on a store without the filter plugin, a filter profile `id` there is rejected with `400`. Any other key is rejected with `400`, and `details[0].code` is `unknown_field`.

name.description: Required when you create a category. 2 to 255 characters. A create rejects a name that a top-level category has, in any letter case, even one in the trash. A `PUT` without it keeps the current name.

sku.description: Generated when you create the category without it.

url.description: At most 255 characters. Made from the name when you create the category without it.

parent_category.description: Send `{"id": ...}` with the parent category's `id`; a `name` beside the `id` is ignored. A `PUT` without it moves the category to the top level.

layout.description: Send `{"id": ...}` with the layout's `id`; a `name` beside the `id` is ignored.

CategoryImagesMediaInput.description: The images you can upload. Each returns as a URL in `image_url` or `background_image_url`. Sending `null` or `""` does not remove a stored image, and sending `image_url` is rejected with `400`.

background_image.description: The background image, stored in a `background/` folder.

CategoryImage.description: One image upload. A `data:` URI string in place of this object returns `500`.

filename.description: The file name, such as `banner.png`. The image's URL ends in it.

CategoryAvailabilityVisibilityInput.description: The `availability_visibility` fields you can write: the fields a response returns, plus `password`. Send booleans as `true` or `false`: a string such as `"false"`, or `null`, returns `200` and leaves the stored value unchanged. A `PUT` that leaves this section out resets it to the defaults of a new category.

available_for.description: Who the category is available to: `everyone`, `customer` or `selected`. Any other value, `null` included, is rejected with `400`.

available_from_date.description: The start of the date range, such as `2026-11-02T00:00:00Z`. A date without a time, such as `2026-11-02`, returns as `2026-11-02T00:00:00Z`.

available_to_date.description: The end of the date range. A date without a time returns at midnight UTC.

password_protected.description: Whether the category is password protected.

password.description: The category's password. It is never returned: responses show only `password_protected`.

custom_sorting.description: Turns custom sorting on for the category.

default_sorting.description: The category's default sort order: `alpha_asc`, `alpha_desc`, `price_desc`, `price_asc`, `created_asc` or `created_desc`. Any other value, `null` included, is rejected with `400`, so a write cannot set it back to `null`.

disable_tracking.description: Turns tracking off for the category.

CategorySelectedCustomersInput.description: The customers and groups the category is available to when `available_for` is `selected`. A customer `id` or group `id` that does not exist is dropped without an error.

products.description: The `id` of each product. The list replaces the category's products, and each product stays in any other category it is in.

code.description: A machine-readable reason, such as `invalid_request`, `not_found` or `conflict`.

message.description: What went wrong, such as `Category name already exists`.

details.description: One entry per rejected field or query parameter.

field.description: The field or query parameter that was rejected.

code.description: Why it was rejected, such as `required`, `unknown_field`, `already_exists`, `invalid_enum`, `too_long`, `invalid_sort_field` or `out_of_range`.

message.description: What was wrong with it.

value.description: The value you sent, when the API includes it.

CategoryServerError.description: The body of a `500`. It has no `error` object.

code.description: Always `500`.

message.description: Always `Unexpected Error Occurred`.

DiscountProfile.description: A discount profile: the 35 fields every profile has, and the one details block its `discount_details_type` names. The listing, [Retrieve a discount profile](/api-reference/discount-profiles/retrieve-a-discount-profile), [Create a discount profile](/api-reference/discount-profiles/create-a-discount-profile) and [Replace a discount profile](/api-reference/discount-profiles/replace-a-discount-profile) return the same fields.

id.description: The discount profile's `id`, assigned by the store. Pass it as `discount_profile_id` in a path.

uuid.description: The profile's `uuid`, assigned by the store.

name.description: The profile's name, unique in any letter case.

type.description: The profile type: `customer`, `promote_product`, `offer_incentive_and_sell_more` or `offer_coupon`, or `""` when the profile was created without one. A replace stores any value you send, including one outside these four.

discount_details_type.description: Which details block the profile has: `amount`, `shipping` or `product`.

amount_details.description: Only on a profile whose `discount_details_type` is `amount`.

shipping_details.description: Only on a profile whose `discount_details_type` is `shipping`.

product_details.description: Only on a profile whose `discount_details_type` is `product`.

start_date.description: When the discount starts, in UTC, written `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss` with no zone suffix, or `null` when not set.

end_date.description: When the discount ends, in UTC, written `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss` with no zone suffix, or `""` when not set.

is_apply_coupon_code.description: Whether the profile uses coupon codes. [Generate coupon codes](/api-reference/discount-profiles/generate-coupon-codes) works only when this is `true`.

default_coupon_code.description: The profile's default coupon code. It is not listed in `customer_coupons`.

is_coupon_code_auto_generate.description: Whether coupon codes are generated automatically.

is_create_unique_coupon_each_customer.description: Whether each customer gets a unique coupon code.

is_imported_coupon.description: Whether the coupon codes are imported.

is_maximum_use_total.description: Whether the discount has a total use limit, set in `maximum_use_count`.

maximum_use_count.description: The total number of uses allowed, or `null`.

is_maximum_use_customer.description: Whether each customer has a use limit, set in `maximum_use_customer_count`.

maximum_use_customer_count.description: The number of uses allowed for each customer, or `null`.

is_maximum_discount_allowed.description: Whether the discount has a maximum amount, set in `maximum_discount_allowed_amount`.

maximum_discount_allowed_amount.description: The maximum discount amount allowed, returned as a decimal such as `200.0`, or `null`.

is_exclude_products_on_sale.description: Whether products on sale are excluded from the discount.

is_discount_used_with_other_discount.description: Whether the discount can be used with other discounts.

is_display_discount_information_prod_det.description: Whether discount information shows on the product detail page.

display_text_partial_discount_condition.description: The partial discount condition display text.

invoice_note.description: A note for the invoice, or `null` when not set.

exclude_products.description: The `id` of each product the discount excludes. A product `id` you sent twice is listed twice.

customer_coupons.description: The coupon codes generated for the profile, in the order they were generated. [Generate coupon codes](/api-reference/discount-profiles/generate-coupon-codes) adds to the end of this list.

usage.description: A list of whole numbers set by the store.

created_on.description: When the profile was created, written `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`, such as `2026-10-07T03:15:42Z`.

last_updated_on.description: When the profile last changed, written like `created_on`. On a new profile it equals `created_on`. Generating coupon codes does not change it.

DiscountProfileCreate.description: Send these fields at the top level of the body, not wrapped in `discount_profile`. `name`, `discount_details_type` and the details block it names are required. Fields the store does not know are dropped, and the profile's `id`, which the store sets itself, is rejected with `400`. The store also accepts `customer`, `customer_group`, `product`, `category`, `is_applied_to_all_customers` and `is_applied_to_all_products`, but no read returns them. `is_maximum_use_limit`, `maximum_use_limit`, `is_maximum_use_limit_by_customer`, `maximum_use_limit_by_customer` and `maximum_discount_allowed` are accepted as other names for `is_maximum_use_total`, `maximum_use_count`, `is_maximum_use_customer`, `maximum_use_customer_count` and `maximum_discount_allowed_amount`; when you send both names, the name the response uses wins.

name.description: Required on create. Spaces at either end are removed. At most 255 characters, unique in any letter case, and without `<`, `>`, `javascript:` or `expression()`. A replace without it keeps the name; a replace with a blank, longer or taken name returns `500`.

type.description: `customer`, `promote_product`, `offer_incentive_and_sell_more` or `offer_coupon`. A create rejects any other value with `400` and the reason `invalid_enum`; a replace stores any value. Without it, a create returns `""` and a replace keeps the current type.

discount_details_type.description: Required on create. `amount`, `shipping` or `product`: the body then needs `amount_details`, `shipping_details` or `product_details`. To change it on a replace, also send the complete details block the new value names; the profile then returns that block and not the old one.

start_date.description: When the discount starts, written `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The store reads it in its own time zone and returns it in UTC. A create rejects a value that is not a real date and time in that form with `400`; a replace stores such a value as `null`. A replace without it sets it to `null`.

is_specify_end_date.description: Whether the profile has an `end_date`. A string such as `"yes"` is rejected with `400`, on create and on replace.

end_date.description: When the discount ends, written like `start_date`. A create stores it only when `is_specify_end_date` is `true`, and then rejects an `end_date` before `start_date` with `400`; a replace stores an earlier `end_date` as sent. A replace without it sets it to `""`.

is_apply_coupon_code.description: Whether the profile uses coupon codes. On create, `true` without a `default_coupon_code` makes the store generate one. [Generate coupon codes](/api-reference/discount-profiles/generate-coupon-codes) works only when this is `true`. A replace that sets it to `true` returns `customer_coupons` as `[]`: retrieve the profile to read its codes.

default_coupon_code.description: The profile's default coupon code. On create, a code another coupon already has is rejected with `400` and the message `Coupon code#<code> already exists`. A replace without it keeps the current code. On a replace that sets `is_apply_coupon_code` to `true`, `""` or `null` makes the store generate a new code in its place; without that flag, `""` keeps the current code.

is_coupon_code_auto_generate.description: Whether coupon codes are generated automatically.

is_create_unique_coupon_each_customer.description: Whether each customer gets a unique coupon code.

is_imported_coupon.description: Whether the coupon codes are imported. A string is rejected with `400`, on create and on replace.

is_maximum_use_total.description: Whether the discount has a total use limit, set in `maximum_use_count`. `is_maximum_use_limit` is accepted as another name.

maximum_use_count.description: The total number of uses allowed. `maximum_use_limit` is accepted as another name. A replace without it sets it to `null`.

is_maximum_use_customer.description: Whether each customer has a use limit, set in `maximum_use_customer_count`. `is_maximum_use_limit_by_customer` is accepted as another name.

maximum_use_customer_count.description: The number of uses allowed for each customer. `maximum_use_limit_by_customer` is accepted as another name. A replace without it sets it to `null`.

is_maximum_discount_allowed.description: Whether the discount has a maximum amount, set in `maximum_discount_allowed_amount`.

maximum_discount_allowed_amount.description: The maximum discount amount allowed. `maximum_discount_allowed` is accepted as another name. A replace without it sets it to `null`.

is_exclude_products_on_sale.description: Whether products on sale are excluded from the discount.

is_discount_used_with_other_discount.description: Whether the discount can be used with other discounts.

is_display_discount_information_prod_det.description: Whether discount information shows on the product detail page.

display_text_coupon.description: The coupon display text. A replace without it keeps the text, and `""` clears it.

display_text_cart.description: The cart display text. A replace without it keeps the text, and `""` clears it.

display_text_partial_discount_condition.description: The partial discount condition display text. A replace without it keeps the text, and `""` clears it.

invoice_note.description: A note for the invoice. A replace without it keeps the note, and `null` clears it.

exclude_products.description: The `id` of each product the discount excludes. Every entry must be an existing product's `id`: one that no product has returns `500` and stores nothing. A numeric string is read as the number, and a product `id` sent twice is kept twice. A replace without it keeps the list, and `[]` clears it.

DiscountProfileReplace.description: Send these fields at the top level of the body. The body replaces the profile: every `is_*` flag you leave out becomes `false`, `start_date` becomes `null`, `end_date` becomes `""`, and `maximum_use_count`, `maximum_use_customer_count` and `maximum_discount_allowed_amount` become `null`. `name`, `type`, `default_coupon_code`, the three display texts, `invoice_note` and `exclude_products` keep their values when you leave them out. Always send the details block of the profile's `discount_details_type`: a body without it returns `500`. `is_maximum_use_limit`, `maximum_use_limit`, `is_maximum_use_limit_by_customer`, `maximum_use_limit_by_customer` and `maximum_discount_allowed` are accepted as other names for `is_maximum_use_total`, `maximum_use_count`, `is_maximum_use_customer`, `maximum_use_customer_count` and `maximum_discount_allowed_amount`; when you send both names, the name the response uses wins.

name.description: Required on create. Spaces at either end are removed. At most 255 characters, unique in any letter case, and without `<`, `>`, `javascript:` or `expression()`. A replace without it keeps the name; a replace with a blank, longer or taken name returns `500`.

type.description: `customer`, `promote_product`, `offer_incentive_and_sell_more` or `offer_coupon`. A create rejects any other value with `400` and the reason `invalid_enum`; a replace stores any value. Without it, a create returns `""` and a replace keeps the current type.

discount_details_type.description: Required on create. `amount`, `shipping` or `product`: the body then needs `amount_details`, `shipping_details` or `product_details`. To change it on a replace, also send the complete details block the new value names; the profile then returns that block and not the old one.
